description: The documented command actually produces both artifacts from raw rows.
cmd: tmp=$(mktemp -d) && python3 -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'python'); from summarize import write_artifacts; rows=[{'category':'Tools','units':2,'revenue':50.0},{'category':'Parts','units':5,'revenue':125.5}]; w=write_artifacts(rows, sys.argv[1]); print('wrote', len(w), 'artifacts')" "$tmp" && test -s "$tmp/category-summary.csv" && test -s "$tmp/summary-brief.md" && rm -rf "$tmp"
provenance: hard rule: the workflow's own command must work as written
